main.remarks: Denies policy evaluation when validated access-key claims are unavailable.

method.name: Evaluate
method.summary: Evaluate whether validated claims are available in the supplied policy context.
method.returns: Deny when validated claims are unavailable; otherwise allow.

method.name: EvaluateAsync
method.summary: Evaluate asynchronously whether validated claims are available in the supplied policy context.
method.param: Cancellation token for the asynchronous stage evaluation.
method.returns: Deny when validated claims are unavailable; otherwise allow.
